question: Who is a well known tabla maestro of the Punjab Gharana?
solution:
Correct Answer __**Alla Rakha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Allah Rakha was a renowned tabla player.**
 
• Ustad Allah Rakha studied voice and **Raag Vidya under Ashiq Ali Khan** of the **Patiala Gharana.**
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri in 1977** and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1982**. 
 
• He was also featured in a **Google doodle on 29 April 2014 on the occasion of his 95th birthday.**
 
• **Zakir Hussain is the eldest son of Ustad Allah Rakha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
